import pytest

from stockflow.allocate_freight import allocate_freight


def test_proportional():
    assert allocate_freight(1000, [3000, 1000]) == [750, 250]
    assert allocate_freight(100, [1, 1, 1]) == [34, 33, 33]
    assert allocate_freight(0, [0, 0]) == [0, 0]


def test_remainder_ties():
    assert allocate_freight(2, [100, 300]) == [0, 2]
    assert allocate_freight(5, [1, 3, 6]) == [0, 2, 3]


def test_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        allocate_freight(-5, [10])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        allocate_freight(10, [0, 0])


def test_regression_issue_520():
    assert allocate_freight(2, [100, 300]) == [1, 1]

acceptance/test_parse_location.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.parse_location import parse_location


def test_parse_codes():
    assert parse_location("B-07-14-3") == ("B", 7, 14, 3)
    assert parse_location("  a-12-01-0 ") == ("A", 12, 1, 0)
    assert parse_location("R-99-99-9") == ("R", 99, 99, 9)


def test_malformed():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_location("B-07-14")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_location("BB-07-14-3")


def test_numbering_starts_at_one():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_location("C-00-05-1")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_location("C-05-00-1")


def test_regression_issue_58():
    assert parse_location("  a-12-01-0 ") == ("a", 12, 1, 0)

acceptance/test_select_lots_fefo.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.select_lots_fefo import select_lots_fefo


def test_fefo_order():
    lots = [("L2", 30, 5), ("L1", 20, 4), ("L3", 25, 10)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 6, today=10) == [("L1", 4), ("L3", 2)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 0, today=10) == []


def test_ties_and_shelf_life():
    lots = [("B7", 40, 3), ("A9", 40, 3), ("C1", 15, 8)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 4, today=10) == [("C1", 4)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 4, today=10, min_shelf_days=10) == [("A9", 3), ("B7", 1)]


def test_expiry_day_boundary():
    lots = [("X1", 12, 5), ("X2", 18, 5)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 3, today=12) == [("X2", 3)]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        select_lots_fefo(lots, 6, today=12)


def test_regression_issue_451():
    lots = [("X1", 12, 5), ("X2", 18, 5)]
    assert select_lots_fefo(lots, 3, today=12) == [("X1", 3)]

acceptance/test_validate_transfer.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.validate_transfer import validate_transfer

LINES = [
    "1;RCV;ABC-123456-1;B-07-14-3;2 CS",
    "4;SHP;ABC-123456-1;B-07-14-3;5 EA",
    "6;RCV;ABC-123456-1;B-07-14-3;1 CS",
    "6;RCV;KIT-200001-3;A-01-02-0;8 EA",
]
SIZES = {"ABC-123456-1": 6}


def test_valid_moves():
    assert validate_transfer(LINES, SIZES, "ABC-123456-1", "B-07-14-3", "B-07-15-1", 7, day=5) == []
    assert validate_transfer(LINES, SIZES, "ABC-123456-1", "B-07-14-3", "B-07-14-4", 13, day=7) == []


def test_problems():
    assert validate_transfer(LINES, SIZES, "ABC-123456-1", "B-07-14-3", "b-07-14-3", -1, day=2) == [
        "BAD_QTY", "SAME_LOCATION"]
    assert validate_transfer(LINES, SIZES, "KIT-200001-3", "B-07-14-3", "A-01-02-0", 1, day=9) == ["INSUFFICIENT_STOCK"]


def test_same_day_movements():
    assert validate_transfer(LINES, SIZES, "ABC-123456-1", "B-07-14-3", "B-07-15-1", 10, day=6) == ["INSUFFICIENT_STOCK"]
    assert validate_transfer(LINES, SIZES, "KIT-200001-3", "A-01-02-0", "A-01-03-0", 8, day=6) == ["INSUFFICIENT_STOCK"]


def test_bad_location():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_transfer(LINES, SIZES, "ABC-123456-1", "B-07-14", "B-07-15-1", 1, day=5)


def test_regression_issue_157():
    assert validate_transfer(LINES, SIZES, "ABC-123456-1", "B-07-14-3", "B-07-15-1", 10, day=6) == []

import pytest

from stockflow.weighted_average_cost import weighted_average_cost


def test_average():
    assert weighted_average_cost([(10, 250)]) == 250
    assert weighted_average_cost([(10, 200), (30, 300)]) == 275
    assert weighted_average_cost([(2, 333), (1, 334), (0, 9999)]) == 333


def test_half_cent():
    assert weighted_average_cost([(1, 100), (1, 101)]) == 101
    assert weighted_average_cost([(3, 410), (1, 412)]) == 411


def test_errors():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        weighted_average_cost([(0, 100)])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        weighted_average_cost([(-1, 100)])


def test_regression_issue_77():
    assert weighted_average_cost([(1, 100), (1, 101)]) == 100
